method: Daily expanded browser review across 12 tracked discussions
coverage: Expanded browser review of 12 tracked discussions: 324 accessible comments out of 339 displayed. Loaded older comments, opened 35 reply/comment controls and 16 deep branches; 15 counted comments remained inaccessible, including a deleted placeholder. Searched r/mbta and r/boston for new discussions. No current sighting changes; historical confirmations and questions were not treated as fresh availability.
